note: The open register window from 2010 bounds the state; its value set is the declared list's two members.
fails_if: `_compile_thin_register` stops copying the coding of an authored variable that names its own list, so COL's state has no value set instead of own-list.csv's members 01 First and 02 Second

sources.description: Authored canonical-SCB register r (open from 2010) whose variable COL names its own list own-list.csv (01 First, 02 Second). Plus the SCB sample.

files.scb_canonical/scb_canonical.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2010-01-01"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"
data_type = "text"
value_set = "own-list"
